title: Pegasus M700
subtitle: 4-Thread Overlock Sewing Machine with HR (Heat-Removing) Needle Cooler

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Pegasus M700 is a 4-thread overlock / overedging sewing machine. Featured: HR device (Heat-Removing / needle cooler) unique to Pegasus machines in this class — prevents heat generation at the needle point, allowing thread to move smoothly and producing uniform stitches. Designed for thick-thread applications in garment production.
applications: Production lines needing consistent stitch quality on thick thread
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, jeans and outerwear finishing

overviewDescription: Made by Pegasus (Japan; with extensive China manufacturing/distribution). The M700 series is the 4-thread overlock in the broader Pegasus lineup. The HR device is the distinguishing feature — Pegasus claims it's exclusive to their machines in this class. Indian distributor markets list the M700 with 220 V motor power and 2 needles / 4 threads.

classificationTable.value: Clutch or servo motor (model-dependent); HR (Heat-Removing) needle cooler
